name: Run Code
description: Run a Python or bash script in this workspace's Linux sandbox and return its output: arithmetic, data, files, charts, anything you'd otherwise estimate. It runs in /work (this chat's scratch); /project keeps files; /public is live web pages, and the reply lists the pages a run changed. numpy, pandas, matplotlib, requests and zola are installed; pip installs persist; the network reaches PyPI only. Use bash to list, read, move and delete files.
author: anything

examples.prompt: What's 17% compound interest on 2,400 over 9 years, year by year?
What files do we have for this project?

timeout.description: Seconds before it's killed: default 60, at most 300.
